subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Paris Métro Opens
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Paris Métro Opens.

hook.text: Paris opened its Métro in 1900, just in time for the World's Fair. Visitors were astonished.

buildup.text: The city chose short trains and tight tunnels—cheaper to build but cramped to ride.

discovery.text: Art Nouveau entrances designed by Hector Guimard turned station mouths into public sculptures.

twist.text: Those ornate entrances almost got demolished in the 1960s. A public outcry saved them.

climax.text: Today the Métro carries 4 million riders daily and its entrances are Parisian icons.

punchline.text: Paris made subway entrances into art.

quiz.question: What made Paris Métro entrances famous?
options: Art Nouveau designs by Hector Guimard
